entities.name: GPRS ciphering key sequence number
entities.description: Information element containing the GPRS ciphering key sequence number used in security context.

entities.name: Inter-system change condition
entities.description: Condition where UE performs A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in EMM-IDLE mode and TIN indicates P-TMSI.

entities.name: EMM-IDLE
entities.description: EPS Mobility Management idle state where UE is registered but has no active signaling connection.

entities.name: Temporary Identity used in Next update (TIN)
entities.description: Temporary identity parameter used by UE to indicate which identity to use.

relations.description: Inclusion of GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE is conditional upon inter-system change with specific TIN value.
Inter-system change condition requires UE to be in EMM-IDLE state.
Inter-system change condition requires TIN to indicate P-TMSI.
